async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Sample Page' link to navigate to another page where a search bar might be available
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page").click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Check if a search bar is present; assume it's a searchbox role with name containing 'search'
    # If not found, this will raise an error, but the task is guaranteed possible
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    # Fill the search bar with the keyword 'DeepSeek'
    await search_bar.fill("DeepSeek")
    # Press Enter to submit the search
    await search_bar.press("Enter")
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Identify the bottom result; assume results are in list items or articles
    # Use .last() to get the bottom result and click it
    bottom_result = page.get_by_role("listitem").last()
    await bottom_result.click()
    # Wait for any navigation or loading after clicking
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
